To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a polymorphism for an esterase, esterase- 16, has been detected in the kidney of the house mouse by means of isozyme analysis and that this esterase is linked to chromosome 3.

we have identified a kidney esterase in the house mouse, that we have characterized this enzyme by means of isozyme techniques, that we have shown that it is a polymorphic locus with three alleles, and that it is closely linked to the Car-1 and the Car-2 loci on chromosome 3.

we have discovered a new kidney esterase locus, Es- 16, with three known alleles, Es- 1 6a, Es- 6b and Es-16 c; the Es- 16 locus is located on the short arm of chromosome 3, closely linked to the Car-1 and the Car-2 loci, and is not linked to the Es- 1 locus on chromosome 7.

the characterization of a kidney arylesterase isozyme and with the linkage relationship of its structural gene locus to chromosome 3 in the house mouse.
